👑 Princess Explorer 👑

Help Princess Explorer visit all her favorite places and collect 7 golden stars!
  • 🚶‍♀️ Walk: W forward · Z back · A left · S right, or the arrow keys, or the joystick on a tablet
  • ✨ Stand on a glowing circle and press E (no keyboard? tap the big round E button)
  • 🏰 The sky-blue 🔑 circle by the castle lowers the drawbridge — walk right in, no questions!
  • 🏆 Right on the 1st try: +10 · 2nd try: +5
  • 🔥 Every 3 right in a row: +5 bonus
  • ⭐ Finish all questions at a place to earn its star
